definitions.content: decision of legal relevance canceling a {{2.05,type approval}}

notes.content:
The withdrawal is justified in case of
— alterations of the type,
— modification of its vital parts,
— circumstances that affect metrological {{5.15,durability}} and/ or reliability,
— effects altering the metrological performance of the instrument required by law and coming to light only after the official {{2.05,type approval}} was granted.

definitions.content: décision de portée légale annulant une {{2.05,approbation de type}}
